FK Rabotnichki, commonly known as Rabotnichki and occasionally by the nickname \"The Romantics\", is a professional football club based in Skopje, North Macedonia. Founded on 4 October 1937, the club plays its home matches at the Toše Proeski Arena, the country's largest stadium, which they share with their city rivals FK Vardar and the North Macedonia national football team. They currently compete in the Macedonian Second Football League.
